facts.fact: The text is Law No. 005 of 2023, the Data Protection Act, which provides in Article 43 that it comes into force on adoption by the Federal Parliament, promulgation by the President and publication in the Official Bulletin, and in Article 5(2) exempts controllers that are not of major importance until the second anniversary of coming into force; the document gives no date, so the published date of 2023-03-22 is used.

Article 6 establishes the Data Protection Authority as an independent agency, constituted on adoption and promulgation of the law and appointment of a General Manager (proposed by the Minister, confirmed by the Cabinet, appointed by the President, Article 13), with a Board of up to nine members to be appointed within two years of the law coming into force (Article 8); the document names no appointee, and the published date of 2023-03-22 is used.

systems.owner: Federal Parliament of Somalia; Minister of Communications and Technology responsible
Established by Article 6 of the Data Protection Act; General Manager and Board of up to nine members

note: No application, regulation or last-twelve-months fact: the text is the law itself, with powers to issue regulations (Article 41) and orders (Article 37) but no instance of either.
